title: Project decals onto brush faces
summary: Place an alpha-blended decal on selected faces without replacing their base material.
outcome: A clipped, editable decal mesh appears on each selected face.

sections.title: Project a decal

steps.title: Select target faces
steps.text: Activate Face mode (S) and select one or more brush faces where the decal should appear.

steps.title: Choose the decal material
steps.text: In the material browser choose an alpha-blended material. Open Project decal in the inspector and confirm the chosen material is shown.

steps.title: Set placement
steps.text: Enter Width, Height, Rotation, and horizontal or vertical offset, then click Project onto selected faces. A decal is centered on each face and clipped at its edges.

steps.title: Inspect and adjust
steps.text: Check Camera. The resulting mesh remains selectable, transformable, and editable; Undo if the material or projection was wrong.

tips: If projection is unavailable, verify that Face mode has brush faces selected and the active material supports alpha blending.
